court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: CRP No. 2010 of 2026 and CMP. No. 8937 of 2026
judgment_text:
PRAYER Civil Revision Petition filed under Article 227 of Constitution of India, prays to set aside the docket order dated 2-2-2026 passed by the The learned I Additional District Judge, Salem in the Unnumbered IA No. of 2026 in OS No. 716 of 2023 rejecting the application filed by the Petitioner herein under Rule 11 of Order VII of CPC as not maintainable and consequently direct the learned I Additional District Judge, Salem to number the said Application and dispose the same on Merits and pass such other or further orders as may be deemed fit and proper in the circumstances of the case and thus render justice.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

T.V. Thamilselvi, J.:— The revision petitioner has filed this revision to set aside the docket order dated 2-2-2026 passed by the The learned I Additional District Judge, Salem in the Unnumbered IA No. of 2026 in OS No. 716 of 2023.

2. The learned counsel for the revision petitioner submitted that, though petitioner is a purchaser of the property and has been added as a necessary party to the proceedings as the 7th defendant, he found that the suit, as such, is not maintainable. He filed an application to reject the plaint, but the trial court was not inclined to take the same on file and returned it on the ground that he is not entitled to file such an application, as he is a purchaser lis pendens. He further submitted that even a purchaser of the property during the pendency of the proceedings is entitled to take all the defences available to the vendor/2nd defendant.

3. Considering the same, this Court finds that the reason assigned is justifiable. Therefore, the trial court is directed to take the unnumbered I.A. No. of 2026 in O.S. No. 716 of 2023 on file and dispose of the same within a period of eight weeks. Liberty is also granted to the defendant to file an application to set aside the ex-parte order before the trial court, in the manner known to law.

4. Accordingly, this Civil Revision Petition is allowed. Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed. No costs.
